summary: Frontend-only testing of unified /venta sales interface. All features working correctly: login, lottery selection, auto-detection of play types (Quiniela/Pale), adding plays to cart for all 22 selected lotteries, and completing sales with ticket modal.

ui_bugs.issue: data-testid attribute not rendered in HTML (React Native Web limitation)
ui_bugs.note: Changed to testID prop but React Native Web may not pass to DOM. Use position-based clicking for automation.
ui_bugs.workaround: Click via green button coordinates or JavaScript click
